🚀 CLI Release Notes

Last updated: 2026-10-31 11:47:34 UTC

Claude CLI

Latest: v2.1.316
  • v2.1.316 2026-10-31
    ▼
    - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off - Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's - Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first - Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt - Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup - Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived - Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell - Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported - Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute - Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted - Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region - Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field - Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in - Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them - Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review - Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them - Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup` - Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict - Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off - Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1` - Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`) - Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them - Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window - Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound - Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows - Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved - Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals - Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine - Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined - Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list - Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow - Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects - Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each - Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts - Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused - [VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed - [VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal - [VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]` - [VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors - [VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits" - [Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it - [Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date - [Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them - [Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff - [Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM - [Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app - [Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run - [Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings - [Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

  • v2.1.314 2026-10-31
    ▼
    - Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode - Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too - Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text - Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired - Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses - Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1 - Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting - Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family - Fixed repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers - Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor - Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out - Fixed `claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH - Fixed extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy - Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once - Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions - Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download - Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model - Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached - Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task) - Fixed background and cloud sessions started with Ultracode turning it back on at their next start after it had been switched off - Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed - Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters - Fixed background diff refreshes briefly taking the repository's index lock, which could make a git command run at the same moment fail with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists" - Fixed markdown tables jumping between grid and stacked layouts on half-typed rows while streaming, and long tables falling back to raw pipes - Fixed the /resume picker showing the text of CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md as a session's title when the session only ran slash commands - Fixed `/btw` answering from the main conversation when asked from a subagent's open transcript - Fixed pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine doing nothing silently; the prompt now says to copy the file over and paste its path - Fixed `claude remote-control` sessions that failed to start when the session service was slow for a moment: the worker's registration is now retried with growing waits - Fixed model switches over Remote Control that take over 8 seconds getting a "still pending" error instead of the final result - Fixed the `sandbox.excludedCommands` setting description saying listed commands always run outside the sandbox; it now says every command in a call must match an entry - Fixed shell and MCP calls that auto mode, a deny rule or a PreToolUse hook blocked, or that otherwise did not run, reading as if they ran in a collapsed tool group - Fixed sandbox protections not applying to a worktree entered by `claude -p --resume` or `--continue` - Fixed hooks matching Bash not running on shell commands started by the Monitor tool; such hooks can block or ask, but not approve or rewrite those commands - Fixed a settings file excluded with `--setting-sources` still supplying some settings, such as auto mode rules and saved permission consents - Fixed auto mode reporting a call as blocked, and listing it in `/permissions`, when its safety check gave no verdict - Fixed a Claude apps gateway Vertex upstream hanging for minutes when a Google token endpoint accepts the connection and never answers - Fixed the Claude apps gateway's start-up warning for a deprecated Claude Desktop key that it still serves as written saying "stops being accepted" after the key's end date - Fixed `/upgrade` opening the browser and starting a new login for plans billed through the App Store or Google Play; it now says where to change the plan - Fixed `--resume`, and rewinding past a switch to another model after a refusal, moving a session on a model name Claude Code doesn't recognize to a different model - Fixed requests failing when a gateway or cloud provider refuses one of Claude Code's beta headers by name: the request is sent again without it - Fixed model IDs spelled with a dot behind an LLM gateway, such as `claude-opus-4.8`, being treated as an older model with the wrong context window, output limit, effort, thinking mode and cost - Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stray "Compacted (ctrl+o to see full summary)" row after /compact - Fixed the cloud sessions tip and the Remote Control idle notice showing when an organization's policy turns those features off - Fixed a resumed claude.ai cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when the previous worker stopped just after receiving a new chat's files - Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions silently dropping a PDF's text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and where to read on - Fixed Claude being told only that a command was declined after you stopped it with Esc or Stop in a cloud session or the IDE; it now also hears that the command may have run - Fixed blank lines at the top of a code block disappearing when the code block opens a quote - Fixed a blank line appearing above some `⎿` rows in the transcript view (Ctrl+O) - Fixed vim mode `dw`, `dW`, `yw` and `yW` carrying on past the end of the line, and made `w` and `W` stop on empty lines - Fixed x and Enter in the agent panel sometimes acting on the wrong agent when another agent started or finished - Fixed pasted text and dragged-in files being lost in Claude's question dialog unless the "Other" row had focus - Fixed pasted text being lost when a row in the prompt footer was selected - Fixed vim mode `p` over a character selection ignoring whether the yanked text was whole lines - Fixed vim mode `aw` and `iw` taking the line break at the end of a line - Fixed ↓ selecting footer items hidden by the ? help menu, the command list or a paste hint - Fixed Esc on a command's panel, such as `/btw`, also interrupting the subagent whose transcript is open - Fixed the welcome header in fullscreen mode showing the session's model while viewing a subagent or teammate that runs on a different model - Fixed the fullscreen transcript being left mid-conversation after "Restore conversation" in the rewind menu while scrolled up - Fixed a rare case where a deleted session could reappear in the resume list as an almost empty entry - Fixed prompts containing tags such as `<bash-stdout>` or `<local-command-stdout>` not being acknowledged to a local stream-json host - Fixed sessions staying untitled when the first prompt failed (for example on a usage limit) and the conversation continued afterward - Fixed the skill file watcher checking every removed skill kept in `~/.claude/skills/.trash`, which added file system load that grew with each removal - Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks for permission or a plan decision, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable - Fixed background sessions that fail to start being reported as a deleted daemon binary when the binary is still on disk - Fixed the tip and idle reminder about push notifications appearing when the push settings in `/config` are hidden or your organization has turned off Remote Control - Fixed `~/.claude/skills/.trash` and `~/.claude/plugins/.trash` growing without limit: each now holds about 1024 entries, whatever `cleanupPeriodDays` says - Fixed the Bash edit diff listing a whole file as changed when a CRLF file under git's line-ending conversion was re-saved unchanged or had one line edited - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an idle session moving to another runner instead of pausing when the runner's request to pause it lost its connection before Anthropic answered - Improved memory use in long headless and SDK turns that run many subagents: the parent session no longer keeps each subagent's tool results until the turn ends - Improved prompt history: Ctrl+R now matches text inside collapsed `[Pasted text]` pills - Improved the `/design-sync` upload prompt to show the folder, the project and the files it will upload or delete - Improved `/permissions` review tab, now called Recently blocked: the footer says what Esc will do with marked rows - Improved auto mode's blocked calls: messages name the command, say Claude may retry and auto mode checks again, and point to `/permissions` to review - Improved permission prompts: a long reason takes fewer rows, so it pushes the command being approved off the screen on fewer terminals - Improved the cloud session error shown while a request refused for your claude.ai login is still being retried: it now also suggests `claude auth login` - Improved the behavior of stored claude.ai, Team, and Enterprise logins when MDM and remote settings differ on base URL or `apiKeyHelper` - Improved `/config` in agent view to say how to stop agent view opening by default - Improved session auto-titles: a session that starts with a skill or a prompt-based command such as `/security-review` now gets a title from it instead of staying untitled - Improved `--resume` speed and memory use on damaged transcripts - Improved `/context` speed in sessions with ten thousand or more MCP tools - Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when a session's branch isn't on the git remote: it now covers a never-pushed branch, says how to fix each case, and no longer suggests retrying - Updated the `/claude-api` skill: its Datadog setup for API tracing now sends the `dd-llmobs-enabled: true` header, as the Console does, and its `ant` install instructions drop the outdated macOS `xattr` step - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to advise printing y-axis tick labels in full under 10,000, and horizontal ones in full under a million where they fit - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to answer donut and pie chart requests with ranked bars or a segmented bar that prints its values - Changed Claude's file tools to ask before editing the local copy of your organization's server-managed settings, as they do for your settings files - Changed `/ultrareview` to check workspace trust before it runs git, as `claude ultrareview` does - Changed the Bash tool's shell to clear any inherited `which` alias or function and to stop passing exported `which`/`unsetenv` functions to commands, so `which` is the system command or zsh builtin - Changed `/permissions` Recently blocked to refuse approving a call you can't read in full, including one the terminal is too short to show - Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a hook's allow of an MCP tool call now counts as no answer, so the classifier or a permission prompt decides - Changed hook `if` conditions such as `Monitor(tail *)` to match the Monitor tool's shell commands as `Bash(tail *)` matches Bash's - Changed the `claude-api` skill to ask to read a Managed Agents workflow run's workflow before changing the agent to improve that run - Changed flagged requests to retry on another model, not end in a refusal, when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `availableModels` or `deniedModels` leaves only an older Opus model, or none - Changed idle compaction to also run for subscribers with telemetry turned off, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and LLM gateways once the one-hour prompt cache is on - Changed `FORCE_HYPERLINK=false` (also `no` and `off`) to turn hyperlinks off instead of on - macOS: Changed `git grep` in most commands that Claude runs to use the C locale, to avoid a reported memory leak in macOS's regex library on files that aren't valid UTF-8 - [VSCode] Fixed "Clear authentication" for MCP servers reporting success when the saved sign-in could not be removed - [VSCode] Fixed missing spinner and Stop button while a queued message's hooks run - [VSCode] Fixed session group changes that cannot be saved, such as a delete, failing silently; an error notification now appears - [VSCode] Fixed Cmd+F / Ctrl+F not opening the find widget in the plan preview tab - [VSCode] Fixed the voice dictation shortcut (Ctrl+D) doing nothing under non-Latin keyboard layouts such as Russian, Greek or Hebrew - [VSCode] Fixed missed one-time saved scheduled tasks being deleted without asking when the extension opened without a chat - [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT` to also stop the extension adding the Claude in Chrome instructions to a session's messages; the browser tools stay available - [Cloud sessions] Added an Include completed button to the Scheduled tasks page when finished one-off tasks are the only ones hidden, so you can show them without opening the Sort menu - [Cloud sessions] Fixed recently used self-hosted environments never appearing among the recent environments on the new session card - [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions reporting uncommitted changes every turn after Claude moved a branch to a commit it had pushed from another worktree - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings squeezing its content out of view in very short windows or at high zoom; the dialog now scrolls - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the permission mode picker staying on Auto after a running cloud or Remote Control session refused the switch; it now shows the mode in use and tells you - [Cloud sessions] Improved scheduled tasks: runs in Anthropic's cloud now load the plugins enabled on your claude.ai account - [Cloud sessions] Improved Test connection for GitHub Enterprise in admin settings to also connect the way cloud sessions do, and to warn you when that second test fails - [Cloud sessions] Improved cloud session transcripts: a rename row now names the new title, and repository and environment lists show as a table instead of one line of JSON - [Cloud sessions] Changed cloud sessions from the web, desktop and mobile apps to start even when a setup script exits with an error, instead of failing to start - [Remote Control] Fixed the permission mode button in Remote Control sessions showing the wrong mode until you typed; while your computer is online it now shows the real mode on open - [Claude Tag] Added a dismissible link to the Claude Tag API docs on the Bundles and Channels tabs in admin settings, for Enterprise organizations with Slack connected - [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` giving up after one failed workspace check in channels shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces; it now retries, then asks you to run it again - [Claude Tag] Fixed a second confirmation DM and channel note when you connect your Claude account from Slack twice from the same link within a few minutes - [Claude Tag] Fixed follow-up messages in Slack showing no sign of progress while Claude's session waits for a self-hosted runner; Claude now posts a wait notice in the thread - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes not answering a tag in its own thread in Slack Connect channels where both organizations have installed Claude - [Claude Tag] Fixed Retry on plugin and skill pages in Claude Tag admin settings discarding unsaved access changes after a failed load; your edits now stay in place - [Claude Tag] Fixed the repositories control in Claude Tag admin settings showing the same action twice; its menu now lists only what the button doesn't already do

  • v2.1.312 2026-10-31
    ▼
    - Added `oidc.user_id_claim` to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid` - Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does - Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension - Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place - Fixed per-directory and `paths:` skills not being found after a Bash `cd` deeper into a git repository - Fixed a rare case where the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be missing the next time the session was resumed - Fixed a command with an invalid name stopping all commands from loading, which could leave `claude -p` with no output - Fixed the Read tool sometimes failing on PDF pages with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" when the clean-up of old session files ran at the same time - Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry `effort` values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force - Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache warning saying the re-read waits for your next message; a change made while Claude is working can trigger it sooner - Fixed some sessions showing as waiting on you when the last message only mentioned items waiting on you mid-sentence - Fixed agent view restoring input text on the next launch after it was cleared with Ctrl+C just before exiting - Fixed agent view reopening in shell mode after exiting with Ctrl+D from an empty `!` input - Fixed vim mode `d`, `c` and `y` with a `gj` or `gk` count larger than the lines left deleting or copying text; like Vim, they now only move the cursor - Fixed `/verify` showing a long description meant for Claude in `/help` and the `/` command menu instead of a short one - Improved the prompt's effort indicator: a change made mid-task now says it may wait for your next message, and the note clears when it no longer applies - Improved WebFetch errors in cloud sessions: a host that does not resolve is now explained as possibly outside the allowed network domains, so Claude names the host to allow - Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Mantle to use the shorter system prompt for model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names and inference profile ARNs, even when they front Sonnet or Haiku; set `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` to keep the full prompt - Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to also cover model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1` to turn them off - Changed usage limit messages to call the 5-hour window the "5-hour limit" instead of the "session limit" - Changed cloud sessions started from the CLI to get their names and branch names from the server - Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout; a `timeout` under 1 second now counts as 1 second - Changed a subagent's `autoCompactWindow` to lower the window set by `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`, where it had no effect before; it still never raises that window - Changed OpenTelemetry `mcp_server.name` to report the real name of fixed-URL remote MCP servers declared by plugins from the official Anthropic marketplace, instead of `custom` - Changed Claude Code to stop sending the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event - [VSCode] Fixed sessions ending on a bare exit code when your organization's settings couldn't be loaded or were refused at startup; the tab now says why and offers Retry or Sign in again - [VSCode] Changed usage limit resets to show a clock time ("Resets at 3:10 PM") and to say "5-hour limit" - [Cloud sessions] Added an effort level to the model picker when you create or edit a routine that runs in the cloud - [Cloud sessions] Added a Bash editor with colors, line numbers and a Copy button to the setup script box in cloud environment settings - [Cloud sessions] Improved the step shown when Claude adds a repository to a cloud session: opening it now shows a short table of what happened instead of raw JSON - [Cloud sessions] Fixed resending an unchanged message after a failed send in a cloud session sometimes running it twice - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed cloud environment creation showing its error only as a toast outside the open dialog; it now appears inside the dialog - [Cloud sessions] Fixed Edit in a routine's menu on the Routines page going to the routine's page without opening its edit dialog - [Remote Control] Fixed an unarchived Remote Control session showing as working until a computer reconnected; it now shows as idle - [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag's retry notice in Slack to name the model in use, or say rate limits were hit, instead of a generic API error - [Claude Tag] Fixed a Claude Tag channel's on/off switch and agent settings falling back to workspace defaults when an older private Slack channel goes public and gets a new ID - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not replying in channels whose environment has network access set to None - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes posting a file in the wrong thread when it was answering in another thread of the same channel - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review reviewing an outdated commit, or none at all, when GitHub delivered a push event late; it now reviews the pull request's current commit

  • v2.1.311 2026-10-31
    ▼
    - Added `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` to `self-hosted-runner`, to keep an idle session while your host reports processes it left running - Added a tip for the Explanatory output style, shown when you ask Claude for explanations - Fixed long freezes at startup and after reading or editing files when a CLAUDE.md file holds a very long list item - Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading - Fixed standard-context sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" when a request ran over 200K tokens; Claude Code now compacts the conversation and continues - Fixed Write and Edit stalling for up to 5 seconds after they ran, and reporting 0 lines changed, when changing thousands of lines in a file - Fixed subagents being unable to use MCP tools from servers that finish connecting after the subagent starts - Fixed Claude seeing stale MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md content right after automatic compaction when those files were edited earlier in the session - Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions saving transcript messages out of order or keeping messages that were taken back - Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks running about twice a minute for each running subagent instead of once when it finishes - Fixed the @ file picker ignoring `.ignore`/`.rgignore` negation rules that re-include git-ignored files - Fixed a subagent's isolated worktree being removed while a background subagent it started was still working in it - Fixed background agents in auto mode that wait on their own shells starting a new main conversation turn on every wake - Fixed the Bash tool description claiming the working directory always persists between calls - Fixed the environment block naming a shell commands don't run in, such as fish when the Bash tool uses zsh - Fixed `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp remove` and `/mcp` naming the current folder instead of the project entry in `~/.claude.json` that holds a local-scope server when run below a repository root - Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` showing the error code twice on failed-connection lines (for example `ENOENT: ENOENT: …`) - Fixed Remote Control sessions staying on "Connecting" for about two minutes when a network proxy blocks a startup request - Fixed messages that Claude sends to a cloud or Remote Control session appearing as your own message in the Claude mobile apps - Fixed Claude not being told the cause when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session could not be saved because the disk was full, or that a message's attachments past the first 20 were left out - Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch hanging on a stalled response in Cowork cloud sessions; an unfinished request now fails after 300 seconds - Fixed a background session that crashed between turns not being restarted while it was attached, pinned, or had a scheduled task or wake-up set - Fixed the "background service did not respond" error suggesting the disabled `claude daemon restart`; it now suggests `claude daemon stop --any` and says it ends background sessions - Fixed `claude respawn <id>` starting the background service before reporting that no background session matches the id - Fixed `/effort` not warning about a prompt cache miss in plan mode when the plan model differs from the session model - Fixed `/ide` saying the VS Code extension was installed before the install finished or when it failed - Fixed the Write tool's file preview skipping rows and miscounting hidden lines when a line is wider than the terminal - Fixed ↑ in an agent's chat tab recalling a message that was still waiting to be delivered, so resending it sent a second copy - Fixed pasting text that mentions an image file, such as `! open /tmp/shot.png` or `/review look at /tmp/shot.png`, attaching the image and dropping its path from the prompt - Fixed the feedback draft card showing its 1/2/0 and Esc shortcuts while the prompt has text, when those keys act on the prompt instead of the card - Fixed a lone backslash in quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, disappearing from Claude's responses - Fixed agent teammates compacting their history when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set - Fixed the rewind menu offering "Summarize from here" and "Summarize up to here" when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set - Fixed a finished `/code-review`, or another skill that runs in a sub-agent, running a second time when a cloud or background session restarts - Fixed long hidden thinking being cut off as idle on Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS, where the endpoint sends thinking progress updates - Fixed `/ide` saying it had installed the JetBrains plugin when nothing was installed - Fixed Claude Pro and Max subscribers being told to ask their admin when their subscription can't be used; the message now points to billing settings - Fixed the diff pane opening by itself after an edit in wide fullscreen terminals when it had nothing to show - Fixed `/mcp` showing a remote server as failed after "Clear authentication" when the server works without sign-in - Fixed `/mcp` showing "authenticated" for a remote server that Claude Code sends no credentials to - Fixed a `--plugin-dir` folder of plugins loading as one plugin when an empty `.mcp.json` was at its top - Fixed `/usage` never showing large prompt-cache misses under "What's contributing to your limits usage?" - Fixed status line links staying plain text in background sessions after you open them from a terminal that supports links - Fixed the /rewind confirmation saying the conversation "will be forked" when the later messages are removed from the conversation - Fixed the /rewind warning that wrongly said manual and Bash edits are never affected by a code restore - Fixed plan approval in screen reader mode sending feedback you had dismissed with Escape - Fixed Claude Code retrying requests the API marked not to retry, which could hold a turn for minutes or, in unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`), indefinitely - Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when a `--plugin-dir` folder was also an added directory and `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` was on - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session failing to start when a rate limit (HTTP 429, or a git wrapper that exits 75) blocks an added read-only repository; it now starts without that repository - Improved startup time for Pro and Max accounts by skipping two network requests on launches within an hour of the last check - Improved `/teleport` and `claude --teleport` to warn when a compacted cloud session loads from its last compaction, so the messages it summarized aren't in the local copy - Improved the messages shown when a background session's process exits: they no longer promise a restart that isn't coming, and they say how to resume the session - Improved artifacts with several views: Claude now routes each view on the link's `#name` and no longer says the address bar stays the same as you switch views - Improved shell commands that reach their timeout: the result now shows the output so far and says the command is still running in the background - Improved compaction: when the model's reply has no summary in it, Claude Code now usually asks for the summary once more before it replaces the conversation - Improved the Artifact tool's choice between a page and a document: explainers and visual or interactive work become artifact pages; documents are for writing people keep editing or pass around - Improved startup time for launches whose only arguments are options and their values, such as `claude --model opus` - Improved the "Connection dropped" API error: it now says where to look first (the proxy or gateway in use, else VPN or firewall; Anthropic API only, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged) - Improved screen reader mode: deleting a rule in /permissions says "Deleted allow rule …" right away - Improved the message shown when a pasted sign-in code is refused: it now says the code may have expired or been used, and to sign in again - Improved Slack connector sends: Claude now checks a channel's topic for posting rules before messaging a channel you didn't name - Improved screen reader mode: Claude's questions are listed as "Questions: Color (answered), Pages", without arrows or symbols - Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn - Changed the `ultrathink` rainbow to appear only where the keyword can raise effort, and not when the word is quoted or part of a file path - Changed Ctrl+D in agent view to match the prompt: on an empty input, pressing it twice exits - Changed `--output-format json` and `stream-json` output to write DEL, C1 control and Unicode format characters inside strings as `\uXXXX` escapes; parsed values are unchanged - Changed model names and IDs to drop the `[1m]` suffix and its label on models where the suffix has no effect; the suffix is still accepted - Changed startup warnings about permission rules in settings files to show once per user until the rule changes - Changed `/code-review` to tell Claude to put the effort level first and use max only when asked - Changed `DISABLE_COMPACT` in settings files and in a mod's `$.env.set` so they can only turn compaction off, not back on - Changed Claude Code on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry to load model settings from a signed file on downloads.claude.ai; set CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG=off to turn this off - Changed sessions that set `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` with feature-flag fetching off to reuse a claude.ai skills list up to 10 minutes old that another session on the machine fetched - Changed clicks on scrollbar arrows and bars in fullscreen lists to act when the mouse button is released, so moving off the scrollbar before letting go cancels the click - Changed `claude purge` to say it deletes data only on this computer, not anything stored by Anthropic - [VSCode] Added syntax coloring to code blocks in Claude's replies, in light, dark and high contrast dark themes - [VSCode] Added a "Running UserPromptSubmit hooks" spinner status and screen reader announcement for slow UserPromptSubmit hooks - [VSCode] Fixed custom skills and custom slash commands sent from the VS Code or JetBrains panel leaving out the open file or selected lines that ordinary messages include (anthropics/claude-code#102799) - [VSCode] Fixed the extension host freezing while the login shell ran its start-up files to read PATH on macOS and Linux - [VSCode] Fixed clicking an image in a tool result, or closing its preview, also opening the result's text in an editor tab - [VSCode] Changed the session list side bar to load Web sessions when the Web tab is first opened, not at startup - [Cloud sessions] Fixed routines in Anthropic-hosted environments staying locked after their owner left the organization and rejoined; the owner can now turn them back on - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed routine API token delete or regenerate showing nothing if the edit dialog had already closed; it now shows an error toast - [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud environment dialogs, including the admin dialog, accepting duplicate names; they now refuse a name another listed environment already has - [Claude Tag] Added a Skills view to Claude Tag analytics showing how often Claude runs each attached skill in Slack channels and which go unused, with Usage links in admin settings - [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag routines that run in a new session: a run with nothing to report can now end without posting a throwaway message to the channel - [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to show a lock instead of # for private Slack channels that your own Slack account can see - [Code Review] Improved Code Review's check run to say no further automatic review will start when the model still can't analyze a change on the automatic retry - [Code Review] Improved Code Review reliability: a review whose session fails to start because of a transient server fault is now retried once automatically, and its check run says so

Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session - Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held - Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error - Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work - Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load - Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error" - Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect - Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305) - Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0` - [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review

Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume` - Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals - Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner - Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression) - Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG` - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open - Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor` - Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept - Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text - Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from - Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off - Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` - Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it - Changed a mod's docked pane to stay within 45% of the terminal's width, including a width kept from a wider terminal - [VSCode] Added a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, with a screen reader announcement, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run - [VSCode] Fixed the spinner cutting off "Compacting..." when your `spinnerVerbs` setting replaces the built-in verbs with short ones - [VSCode] Changed the message shown when a session does not start in time and no hook is running: it now leads with the output logs and lists causes instead of pointing to sign-in and network first - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud environments admin page wrongly refusing to save an existing environment with an "installs packages" error - [Cloud sessions] Improved deleting a self-hosted environment so the dialog and error messages say what blocks the delete and what it will affect - [Claude Tag] Added public Slack channels Claude hasn't joined to the Claude Tag admin Add place search, so admins can set one up from there - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag access bundles so a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added again - [Claude Tag] Fixed a routine set up in a Slack DM thread no longer posting after another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; both now keep posting there - [Claude Tag] Fixed routines set up in a Slack thread reporting success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told - [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin pages in large organizations so plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review sometimes not reviewing the newest commit when several pushes landed on a pull request during a review - [Code Review] Changed Code Review re-reviews so they no longer open with LGTM while earlier blocking findings are still open

Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything - Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O) - Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it - Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config` - Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder - Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed - Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one - Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded - Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged - Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans - Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give - Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path - Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions - Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal - Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan - Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions - Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field - Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout - Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc - Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error - Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error - Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a conversation the API had rejected as too long - Fixed subagents sometimes forgetting their most recent work when they were messaged or resumed right after finishing - Fixed `claude --help` text for `--tools`, `--resume`, `--debug`, `--json-schema`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--system-prompt-snapshot` and `claude update` to match actual behavior - Fixed `claude --worktree` removing the worktree and its branch without asking at exit when HEAD was detached or on another branch, which could lose commits - Fixed resumed and cloud sessions sending Claude the whole skill list again each time plugins reloaded at startup - Fixed an interrupt not ending a Read that waits on an idle pipe or device named like an image - Fixed `/effort status`, `/effort ultracode` and the prompt's effort indicator showing a guessed effort level when `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is `auto` or `unset` and no level is sent - Fixed a PreToolUse hook's deny reason being replaced by a timeout error when an Agent SDK callback hook on the same tool call timed out - Fixed Bash and PowerShell deleting a large command's output file when it could not be copied to the session's tool-results folder, unless the disk is full - Fixed notes typed into a multiple-choice question with previews being cut off with "…" in terminals under about 100 columns, hiding what was typed (anthropics/claude-code#82768) - Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups scheduled at the 1-hour maximum firing just after the 1-hour prompt cache expired, so those wakeups no longer re-read the conversation uncached - Fixed agent teams: approving a shutdown request from the main session no longer exits the whole CLI - Fixed a skill's `once` hook also removing another skill's identical hook after it ran - Fixed transcript mode's `{` and `}` landing the prompt on an inconsistent row, or off screen, instead of the transcript's first row - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k` silently setting a 100K window: the variable now accepts `k` and `M` suffixes like `--autocompact`, and warns when a value is out of range or ignored - Fixed Ctrl+C in the agents view clearing a text selection without copying it when pressed before the mouse button was released - Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment" - Improved the lines shown when a mod written in the session loads, reloads or fails to load - Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views - Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins synced from claude.ai, unless a server sets `alwaysLoad: true` - Improved how a remote session recovers its status when the server refuses a status update that carried other session data - Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request - Improved the `claude -p` invalid-settings warning: a file that did not load lists only what stopped it, and long lists are capped per file - Improved resume of large compacted sessions in SDK and headless mode: the first request after resuming is sent sooner - Improved responsiveness and throughput when many subagents are running at the same time - Improved memory use when sending requests in long or resumed conversations - Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when the git host answers "not found" for a session's repository: it now names the repository and whom to ask - Windows: Improved git command start-up with a standard Git for Windows install by running its git.exe directly instead of through its cmd launcher - Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses - Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work - Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on - Changed tool search to be on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; a 400 or 422 from the gateway is retried without it - Changed compaction to send Claude the skill list again afterwards; `/reload-skills` now sends only new or changed skills - Changed skill hooks: the skills of one source (a repo, your own folder, or a plugin) can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters per session - Changed skills under a policy that allows hooks from plugins only: a skill used in the main conversation whose hooks are kept out no longer gets its `allowed-tools` - Updated the /claude-api skill to use the `ant` CLI on Claude Platform on AWS instead of falling back to the SDK or curl - Removed the notes from `claude plugin validate` that predicted where a mod's hooks would run - Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5 - [VSCode] Added mod drawing in the chat panel for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, behind an LLM gateway, or with telemetry turned off - [VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total - [VSCode] Fixed a session closed while it was starting keeping its Claude Code process running until the start ended - [VSCode] Fixed a mod's drawings disappearing from a long-open panel until the next turn on machines that also run an older Claude Code - [VSCode] Fixed Past conversations hiding sessions when `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` is set - [VSCode] Changed background sub-agents to show as one status line under their Agent card instead of streaming every step into the chat; the full transcript stays in /tasks - [Cloud sessions] Fixed folders in the composer's @ list showing no name in cloud sessions, where picking one added only a space instead of a mention - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread - [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !fork` typed outside a thread getting no visible reply; Claude now shows you a private note saying to run it from inside a thread - [Code Review] Added review levels to Code Review: Owners choose Quick, Standard (the default), or Deep for the organization, and can give individual repositories their own level - [Code Review] Added an option in Code Review admin settings to review every repository in a GitHub organization, including ones added later, without selecting them one by one - [Code Review] Fixed pull requests opened within a minute or two of an admin turning on Code Review being silently skipped; they are now retried and reviewed

    - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode - Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings - Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope` - Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits - Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks - Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin` - Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists - Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist - Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process - Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format - Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir` - Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows - Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied - Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in" - Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto - Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them - Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default - Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows - Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache - Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn - Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin - [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code - [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string - [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached - [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it - [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice - [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back - [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong" - [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker

Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back - Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right - Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off - Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type` - Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before - Added the `prompt.change` mod hook, raised when the prompt box's text changes without a typed edit: a recalled history entry, a clear, an undo, or a plugin's fill - Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did - Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window - Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running - Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted` - Fixed `claude agents` not refreshing any pull request's status when the data for one of them came back incomplete - Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once - Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation - Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child - Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft - Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume - Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login` - Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories - Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does - Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short - Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`) - Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage - Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being recorded as typed in the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event and interaction span, and in session title requests - Fixed a note meant for Claude about mod hot-reloading appearing in the transcript as if you had typed it - Fixed agent hooks ignoring their `model`: aliases like `haiku` now resolve, a subagent's model no longer overrides it, and an unavailable model falls back to the caller's instead of allowing the action - Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's - Fixed the branch showing as ".invalid" and `--worktree` failing to reopen a worktree in repositories using git's reftable ref storage - Fixed Claude naming files in the session scratchpad by a bare filename or relative path instead of their full path - Fixed `claude remote-control` servers giving up on renewing their connection after a brief sign-in error, such as a locked keychain; they now retry, and warn when you need to run `claude /login` - Fixed `--worktree` failing in a worktree of a bare repository when origin's default branch can't be fetched; the fallback base is now the current checkout's HEAD, not the main repository's - Fixed starting Claude Code in a VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop integrated terminal launching the editor's command-line tool twice to check for the extension; it now launches it once - Fixed a mod's `prompt.edit` hook not being raised for a newline entered with the `chat:newline` keybinding (Ctrl+J, or a rebound Enter) - Fixed a conversation failing on every turn with a 400 error when the API rejected an MCP tool's input schema; Claude Code now sends that tool without parameters for the rest of the conversation - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on) - Fixed Claude not being told about an MCP server's tools and instructions until its next tool call, when the server finished connecting after a compaction - Fixed Remote Control sessions being marked stopped while still running, on a computer serving several sessions at once - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing its compaction summary or bringing back pre-compaction history, when the compaction followed a retried or unfinished reply in the same turn - Fixed Claude polling a background command's output file or sleeping while it runs - Fixed feature flags and staged rollouts staying stale behind a TLS-inspecting proxy whose certificate is trusted only through the OS certificate store - Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` printing "stopped" while a stuck background service kept running: it now waits, force-kills the service, and says so with exit 1 if it is still there - Fixed `claude daemon stop` exiting with no output, and leaving sessions listed as running, when telemetry is turned off - Fixed Write, Edit and NotebookEdit in Cowork cloud sessions reporting success for a path on your own computer, where the file never arrived - Fixed Claude searching for deferred tools already loaded earlier in the conversation when a session resumes a history that never listed them - Fixed secondary (dim) text looking the same as normal text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals - Fixed cloud sessions hanging 5 minutes per turn when the organization's policy can't be read; the turn now ends promptly and says why - Fixed a cloud session sometimes running an already answered message a second time after the session restarted during a long reply - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows) - Improved WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions to tell Claude that a page failed moments ago instead of fetching it again - Improved mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude scans a mod's files for keys before opening them, and asks before scanning a folder outside the project - Improved the note Claude 3 models get about an @-mentioned PDF, so they less often answer without reading it - Improved artifact updates: Claude now applies a small change and republishes the artifact in one call, and makes larger edits and republishes within a single response - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` sessions to ignore CA-bundle, tool-proxy, git TLS and git config variables like `SSL_CERT_FILE` in settings; under Claude Desktop, only in project settings - Changed exit to force-kill background commands still running 1.5 seconds after being asked to stop; in fullscreen mode they could previously be left running - Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start - Changed `claude gateway` to stop at start, naming the key, on a `desktop:` policy key that Claude Desktop cannot use from a gateway, where it earlier started with a warning - Changed large requests to api.anthropic.com to use gzip compression even when telemetry is disabled; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` to turn it off - Changed the `claude-api` skill to leave Managed Agents sessions in place unless you ask to archive or delete them - Changed background sessions to resume a carried workflow through the Workflow tool's approval instead of running it from the handoff file - Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt, tools and parameters, so a transcript you choose to share can reproduce a request exactly - Changed the `/sandbox` mode options to read "Sandbox commands" instead of "Sandbox BashTool" - Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks in Cowork cloud sessions: a `setMode` update in a hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies - Changed hooks: `updatedInput` from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks is now validated like Claude's own input: unknown keys are dropped, and input the tool rejects denies the call - Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions - [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting to stop text selected in the editor from being added to your messages - [VSCode] Fixed fast mode staying on after usage credits ran out, which made each request be refused and re-sent; it now turns off until you turn it back on, with an error notice - [VSCode] Fixed the Thinking toggle switching to Off on models that always think; the toggle is no longer shown for those models - [VSCode] Fixed "Edit prompt" on a flagged message opening the file or command menu over the restored prompt; Enter now sends it as written - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file onto the prompt on Windows inserting an unreadable `/c:/…` path instead of a mention relative to the working directory - [VSCode] Fixed changes to VS Code's chat font size settings needing a window reload or being undone by a theme change; diffs and the plan preview now follow them too - [VSCode] Fixed "Resume session" and tabs restored after a reload opening an empty new conversation instead of one that had moved into a git worktree - [VSCode] Fixed ↑ then Enter on a recalled slash command running it without its arguments; the command and file menus no longer open over a recalled prompt until you edit it - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file from the Explorer or an editor tab onto the prompt inserting nothing in WSL, SSH and Dev Container windows - [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Alt+F toggling Focus view instead of opening Find in the Explorer, other tree views, or the Debug Console on Windows and Linux - [VSCode] Fixed the check for sessions open in other windows or terminals creating extra processes on macOS: it now starts `/bin/ps` directly instead of searching PATH for `ps` on every check - [VSCode] Windows: Fixed a conversation showing "still open somewhere else" after a crash or power loss, when Windows had since restarted and given the old process ID to another program - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Allow for this task" missing from Cowork's approval prompts for connector tools where an organization turns off "Always allow" (regression in 2.1.292) - [Cloud sessions] Fixed most commands in the / menu losing their descriptions in cloud sessions once you sent a second message - [Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified; requires Claude Code v2.1.296 or later on your machine - [Claude Tag] Added support for Slack Connect channels: an Owner or Claude Tag admin can let Claude in Slack answer in channels shared with another organization; it's off by default - [Claude Tag] Added a private Allow once / Deny card in Slack threads for connector actions that need your approval, so Claude asks instead of refusing; others only see that it's waiting on you - [Claude Tag] Added support for Slack voice clips in Claude in Slack: Claude reads Slack's transcript of a clip when Slack has one - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not answering another app that tags it in a thread under a message Claude itself posted to the channel - [Claude Tag] Changed access bundles an admin attached to a Slack channel to keep applying once the channel becomes a Slack Connect channel, with no need to remove and re-attach them - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review ignoring `@claude review` comments from people with write access whose GitHub organization membership is private; their comments now start a review - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review's "paused for this repository" comment sending admins to Code Review settings; it now says who can fix it and links the Git providers page
