Run `/workflows` to view your runs - Fast mode on Opus 4.8 is now available at a fraction of its previous cost: 2x the standard rate for 2.5x the speed - The lean system prompt is now the default for all models except Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus 4.7 and earlier - Claude now reserves the multiple-choice question prompt for decisions it genuinely cannot make itself, instead of asking when it already has enough context to proceed - `/simplify` now runs a cleanup-only review (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) and applies the fixes, instead of running the full `/code-review --fix` bug-hunting review - Renamed the `/effort` slider labels from "Speed"/"Intelligence" to "Faster"/"Smarter" for clarity - `claude agents`: type `! <command>` to run a shell command as a background session you can attach to and detach from. Also available as `claude --bg --exec '<command>'` - `claude agents`: `/logout` now signs you out instead of being sent to a background session - `←←` to open the agents view now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled - Claude in Chrome: pick which connected browser to use via `/chrome` → "Select browser…", or in-chat when a browser action runs with multiple connected - Plugins can now declare `defaultEnabled: false` in `plugin.json` or a marketplace entry; enable them with `/plugin` or `claude plugin enable`. Dependencies of enabled plugins are still enabled automatically - The `/plugin` Discover tab now pins plugins whose relevance signals match the current directory with a "suggested for this directory" annotation - Streaming tool execution is now always enabled, including when telemetry is disabled or on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (previously behind a feature flag) - Stdio MCP server subprocesses now receive `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` and `CLAUDECODE=1` in their environment - `claude mcp list`/`get` now show unapproved `.mcp.json` servers as `⏸ Pending approval` instead of auto-approving and connecting when output is piped - `/remote-control` autocomplete now shows "Disconnect Remote Control" when Remote Control is already active - Added Claude Opus 4.8 support and 4.7 → 4.8 migration guidance to the `/claude-api` skill - Deprecated `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE` (will be removed on 06/01). To use fast mode on Opus 4.6, switch with `/model claude-opus-4-6[1m]` and then `/fast on` - Improved the auto-mode classifier's detection of data exfiltration, particularly bulk transfers of repository contents - Fixed `rm -rf $HOME` not being blocked as a dangerous path when `HOME` has a trailing slash - Fixed `$TMPDIR` resolving to different directories in sandboxed vs unsandboxed Bash commands within the same session - Fixed unreadable highlighted-row text in `claude agents` when the Claude Code theme doesn't match the terminal background - Fixed background-agent completion notifications triggering premature "out of context" behavior on some 1M-context models - Fixed background-session classifier losing the user's goal when a scheduled `/command` fires - Fixed pinned background sessions respawning every minute after a Claude Code update, causing repeated agent-start notifications and process churn at idle - Fixed background sessions stuck at "blocked", "running", or "working" not retiring after the idle grace period - Fixed subagents in background sessions bypassing the worktree-isolation guard and writing to the shared checkout - Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon exits on macOS - Fixed number key shortcuts not working for options shown below the divider in option dialogs - Fixed `worktree.baseRef: "head"` resolving to the main checkout's HEAD instead of the current worktree's HEAD when spawning subagents or calling `EnterWorktree` from inside a linked worktree - Fixed a stray leading space on wrapped lines when the previous line ended exactly at the terminal width - Fixed intermittent terminal rendering corruption in VS Code by capping the number of distinct colors the thinking spinner produces - Fixed plan file names including `[Image #N]` / `[Pasted text #N]` placeholders when a plan-mode prompt starts with pasted images or text - Fixed a phantom expand/click affordance on colored tool output: short ANSI-colored lines that fit on screen no longer show a "ctrl+o to expand" hint - Fixed a single invalid `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` entry in managed settings discarding all managed-settings policy; the bad entry is now dropped with a `claude doctor` warning - Fixed API 400 errors on models that don't support the effort parameter when `CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT` is set - Windows: Fixed update failures caused by `claude.exe` being in use showing a generic error instead of telling you to close other sessions and retry - Removed the stale "& for background" hint from the shortcuts help panel - [VSCode] Auto mode no longer requires the bypass-permissions setting to appear in the mode picker, and a dismissable notice on the new-session screen explains auto mode the first time it's active - Fixed the task panel below the prompt showing a stray unselectable "main" row when only a workflow is running - Fixed /mcp tools list and tool detail rendering when MCP servers have long or multi-line tool names or long descriptions - Fixed the /model picker not showing fast mode pricing on the Default option for API (pay-as-you-go) users when fast mode is on -     - Added `claude remote-control` subcommand for external builds, enabling local environment serving for all users. - Updated plugin marketplace default git timeout from 30s to 120s and added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` to configure. - Added support for custom npm registries and specific version pinning when installing plugins from npm sources - BashTool now skips login shell (`-l` flag) by default when a shell snapshot is available, improving command execution performance. Improved VS Code plan preview: auto-updates as Claude iterates, enables commenting only when the plan is ready for review, and keeps the preview open when rejecting so Claude can revise. - Fixed a bug where bold and colored text in markdown output could shift to the wrong characters on Windows due to `\r\n` line endings. - Fixed compaction failing when conversation contains many PDF documents by stripping document blocks alongside images before sending to the compaction API (anthropics/claude-code#26188) - Improved memory usage in long-running sessions by releasing API stream buffers, agent context, and skill state after use - Improved startup performance by deferring SessionStart hook execution, reducing time-to-interactive by ~500ms. - Fixed an issue where bash tool output was silently discarded on Windows when using MSYS2 or Cygwin shells. - Improved performance of `@` file mentions - file suggestions now appear faster by pre-warming the index on startup and using session-based caching with background refresh. - Improved memory usage by trimming agent task message history after tasks complete - Improved memory usage during long agent sessions by eliminating O(n²) message accumulation in progress updates - Fixed the bash permission classifier to validate that returned match descriptions correspond to actual input rules, preventing hallucinated descriptions from incorrectly granting permissions - Fixed user-defined agents only loading one file on NFS/FUSE filesystems that report zero inodes (anthropics/claude-code#26044) - Fixed plugin agent skills silently failing to load when referenced by bare name instead of fully-qualified plugin name (anthropics/claude-code#25834) - Search patterns in collapsed tool results are now displayed in quotes for clarity - Windows: Fixed CWD tracking temp files never being cleaned up, causing them to accumulate indefinitely (anthropics/claude-code#17600) - Use `ctrl+f` to kill all background agents instead of double-pressing ESC. Background agents now continue running when you press ESC to cancel the main thread, giving you more control over agent lifecycle. - Fixed API 400 errors ("thinking blocks cannot be modified") that occurred in sessions with concurrent agents, caused by interleaved streaming content blocks preventing proper message merging. - Simplified teammate navigation to use only Shift+Down (with wrapping) instead of both Shift+Up and Shift+Down. - Fixed an issue where a single file write/edit error would abort all other parallel file write/edit operations. Independent file mutations now complete even when a sibling fails. - Added `last_assistant_message` field to Stop and SubagentStop hook inputs, providing the final assistant response text so hooks can access it without parsing transcript files. - Fixed custom session titles set via `/rename` being lost after resuming a conversation (anthropics/claude-code#23610) - Fixed collapsed read/search hint text overflowing on narrow terminals by truncating from the start. - Fixed built-in slash commands (`/help`, `/model`, `/compact`, etc.) being hidden from the autocomplete dropdown when many user skills are installed (anthropics/claude-code#22020) - Fixed MCP servers not appearing in the MCP Management Dialog after deferred loading - Fixed session name persisting in status bar after `/clear` command (anthropics/claude-code#26082) - Fixed crash when a skill's `name` or `description` in SKILL.md frontmatter is a bare number (e.g., `name: 3000`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25837) - Added `added_dirs` to the statusline JSON `workspace` section, exposing directories added via `/add-dir` to external scripts (anthropics/claude-code#26096) - Fixed `claude doctor` misclassifying mise and asdf-managed installations as native installs (anthropics/claude-code#26033) - Fixed image pasting not working on WSL2 systems where Windows copies images as BMP format (anthropics/claude-code#25935) - Fixed background agent results returning raw transcript data instead of the agent's final answer (anthropics/claude-code#26012) - Fixed Warp terminal incorrectly prompting for Shift+Enter setup when it supports it natively (anthropics/claude-code#25957) - Fixed CJK wide characters causing misaligned timestamps and layout elements in the TUI (anthropics/claude-code#26084) - Fixed custom agent `model` field in `.claude/agents/*.md` being ignored when spawning team teammates (anthropics/claude-code#26064) - Fixed plan mode being lost after context compaction, causing the model to switch from planning to implementation mode (anthropics/claude-code#26061) - Fixed `alwaysThinkingEnabled: true` in settings.json not enabling thinking mode on Bedrock and Vertex providers (anthropics/claude-code#26074) - Fixed `tool_decision` OTel telemetry event not being emitted in headless/SDK mode (anthropics/claude-code#26059) - Fixed session name being lost after context compaction — renamed sessions now preserve their custom title through compaction (anthropics/claude-code#26121) - Increased initial session count in resume picker from 10 to 50 for faster session discovery (anthropics/claude-code#26123) - Windows: fixed worktree session matching when drive letter casing differs (anthropics/claude-code#26123) - Fixed `/resume <session-id>` failing to find sessions whose first message exceeds 16KB (anthropics/claude-code#25920) - Fixed "Always allow" on multiline bash commands creating invalid permission patterns that corrupt settings (anthropics/claude-code#25909) - Fixed React crash (error #31) when a skill's `argument-hint` in SKILL.md frontmatter uses YAML sequence syntax (e.g., `[topic: foo | bar]`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25826) - Fixed crash when using `/fork` on sessions that used web search — null entries in search results from transcript deserialization are now handled gracefully (anthropics/claude-code#25811) - Fixed read-only git commands triggering FSEvents file watcher loops on macOS by adding --no-optional-locks flag (anthropics/claude-code#25750) - Fixed non-interactive subcommands like `claude doctor` and `claude plugin validate` being blocked inside nested Claude sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25803) - Windows: Fixed the same CLAUDE.md file being loaded twice when drive letter casing differs between paths (anthropics/claude-code#25756) - Fixed inline code spans in markdown being incorrectly parsed as bash commands (anthropics/claude-code#25792) - Fixed teammate spinners not respecting custom spinnerVerbs from settings (anthropics/claude-code#25748) - Fixed sessions with large first prompts (>16KB) disappearing from the /resume list (anthropics/claude-code#26140) - Fixed shell functions with double-underscore prefixes (e.g., `__git_ps1`) not being preserved across shell sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25824) - Fixed background tasks failing in git worktrees due to remote URL resolution reading from worktree-specific gitdir instead of the main repository config (anthropics/claude-code#26065) - Fixed Right Alt key leaving visible `[25~` escape sequence residue in the input field on Windows/Git Bash terminals (anthropics/claude-code#25943) -     ## New Features - Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224) - Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292) - Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293) - Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232) - Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365) - Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606) ## Bug Fixes - Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227) - Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502) - Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503) - Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635) - Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788) - Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820) - Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839) ## Chores - Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832) - Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837) - Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0.   • v0.165.0 2026-10-27
    ▼
    ## New Features - Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265) - Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337) - Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308) - Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351) - Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163) - Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414) ## Bug Fixes - Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090) - Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091) - Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132) - Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330) - Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445) - Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns.   • v0.164.0 2026-10-23
    ▼
    ## New Features - Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381) - Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383) - Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216) - Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001) - Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049) - The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023) ## Bug Fixes - Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581) - Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923) - Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000) - CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022) - Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682) - Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384) ## Chores - Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856) - Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations.   • v0.163.0 2026-10-15
    ▼
    ## New Features - Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429) - Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835) - Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273) - Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173) - Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245) - Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717) ## Bug Fixes - Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424) - The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506) - Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436) - On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453) - Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622) - `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444) ## Documentation - Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768) - Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610) ## Chores - Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213) - Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.1 Source: CLI built from source (same branch/ref as SDK) --- ## Highlights The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022: - Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights - Generated UI cards keep inputs and state across navigation and split views, show live views after initial calculation, and appear only for clients that can render MCP Apps. ([#15611](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15611), [#15787](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15787), [#15720](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15720), [#15790](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15790)) - Persistent session Workflow mode can be enabled with --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, or ACP, and workflow switches now reach the CLI sandbox. ([#15422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15422), [#15743](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15743)) - Tool results shrink to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, and qwen-latest-series- or qwen4 aliases are detected with 1M-token context windows. ([#13599](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599), [#15758](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15758), [#15762](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15762)) - Valid XML tool calls are recovered when parameters quote other call markup, malformed blocks are isolated, and quoted examples are not dispatched. ([#13579](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13579)) - ACP and daemon clients keep rewind identity consistent across retries, cancellations, checkpoints, recordings, and notifications, while SDK frames preserve subagent identity. ([#15441](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15441), [#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657)) - /autofix-pr start stops when the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. ([#15736](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15736)) ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - feat(memory): opt-in extraction cadence after a no-op run ([#13571](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13571)) by @yiliang114 - Shrinks tool results to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, respecting explicit truncation settings and protected content to reduce unnecessary compaction. ([#13599](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599)) by @yiliang114 - Keeps eligible Generated UI cards alive across history navigation, session switching, and split-view changes in the same page, preserving inputs, controls, and runtime state. ([#15611](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15611)) by @qqqys - Adds persistent session Workflow mode through --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, and ACP controls, with saved mode shown in Ink and OpenTUI. ([#15422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15422)) by @qqqys - Adds opt-in composerVariant simple to Web Shell, providing a compact input with a limited add menu and shared editor, attachments, and session actions. ([#15663](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15663)) by @samuelhsin - /autofix-pr start now stops if the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. ([#15736](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15736)) by @wenshao - Adds administrator-driven reclamation and reuse of idle resident CSI Workspaces with cleanup verification and atomic release. ([#15729](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15729)) by @doudouOUC - OpenTUI terminals now draw the Mods band above the prompt and run Mod ui.render hooks there, matching the Ink terminal experience. ([#15699](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15699)) by @qqqys - ACP live frames, persisted replays, SDK normalization, and transcript reduction now preserve subagent identity for thoughts, messages, and tool frames. ([#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657)) by @yiliang114 - Archived conversations are now managed in Settings → Archived conversations in Web Shell, keeping archive groups, filters, and lifecycle actions. ([#15557](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15557)) by @deggs7 - Managed Agent can now be embedded opt-in in a Java host's JVM and Spring context, with dedicated connection pooling or a supplied DataSource. ([#15718](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15718)) by @yiliang114 - /verify-pr now supports a failures ledger and rejects findings or blocked verdicts unless failures are attributed to the PR. ([#15764](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15764)) by @wenshao - Adds the qwen-managed-agent-admin launcher for running managed-agent offline maintenance commands by name, with help and unknown-command handling. ([#15772](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15772)) by @wenshao - feat(generated-ui): check a view's initial calculation before display ([#15790](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15790)) by @qqqys ### Bug Fixes - Recovers valid XML tool calls when parameters quote other call markup, isolates malformed blocks, and prevents quoted examples from being dispatched. ([#13579](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13579)) by @yiliang114 - Carries rewind identity through ACP/daemon clients so retries, cancellations, checkpoint resolution, recording, and notifications stay consistent. ([#15441](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15441)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes release publishing checkout failures by using the run-scoped GitHub token for read-only checkout while keeping the bot PAT for write steps. ([#15728](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15728)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Pins pull request CI retries to the head SHA from the triggering event so reruns test the intended commit. ([#15734](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15734)) by @yiliang114 - fix(cli): forward workflow switches into the CLI sandbox (#15740) ([#15743](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15743)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Recognizes invite-only qwen-latest-series- model aliases as 1M-context models in the context-window detector. ([#15758](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15758)) by @wenshao - Makes daemon-managed channels honor approvalMode even when no webhooks are configured, matching standalone startup. ([#15754](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15754)) by @qqqys - Shows the exception class in managed-agent scan summaries for non-first row failures that have no message. ([#15725](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15725)) by @yiliang114 - Workspace Skill inventory queries now return a retained snapshot immediately and refresh in the background, while cold reads, deletion, and enablement wait for fresh data. ([#14890](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14890)) by @callmeYe - qwen4 model identifiers are now sized with a 1,000,000-token context window by default when no upstream catalog entry defines them. ([#15762](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15762)) by @wenshao - Acceptance tests now wait for the focused shell Tab byte to reach the child process before asserting exact input bytes, preventing flaky failures. ([#15763](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15763)) by @yiliang114 - Managed runtime distribution now publishes verified server artifacts to GitHub Releases and OSS without requiring Maven Central, keeping CLI downloads unchanged. ([#15782](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15782)) by @doudouOUC - Generated UI is now offered only to sessions whose client can render MCP Apps, while unsupported clients receive a clear unsupported-client reason. ([#15720](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15720)) by @qqqys - In Web Shell, live Generated UI cards now attach and show their interactive view immediately when tool results arrive instead of requiring reopen. ([#15787](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15787)) by @qqqys - Desktop release preparation now resets Git metadata on self-hosted runners before checkout to avoid stale-workspace failures. ([#15761](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15761)) by @yiliang114 ### Documentation - Documents managed-agent shared-Session queue behavior and advises giving slow-probed gated definitions their own Session. ([#15724](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15724)) by @yiliang114 ### Internal Changes - Internal tests now compare git worktree prune dry-run results as an unordered set, making them insensitive to git output order. ([#15767](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15767)) by @yiliang114 - Managed snapshot pool test setup now allows a three-second database connection lease so schema creation on busy CI runners is less likely to fail. ([#15749](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15749)) by @yiliang114 - Installed npm and private Bun acceptance tests now run nightly and by manual dispatch instead of on every PR update, while source TUI PR behavior stays unchanged. ([#15719](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15719)) by @yiliang114 - Improved Managed Agent reliability testing by adding terminal recovery fault gates for failover scenarios. ([#15756](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15756)) by @wenshao - Improved CLI test stability for review cleanup orphan-process handling by making process liveness deterministic. ([#15751](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15751)) by @yiliang114 - Hosted gates now use a shared zombie-aware liveness check, improving consistency when waiting for processes to stop. ([#15777](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15777)) by @wenshao **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/compare/v0.26.2...v0.26.3

Highlights The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022: - Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes - fix(managed-agent)!: simplify Web Shell controls and retire cwd submissions ([#15616](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15616)) by @doudouOUC ## Complete Change List ### Features - feat(managed): add session permission rules and Auto approval ([#15448](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15448)) by @doudouOUC - feat(core): add an experimental shared agent loop and run headless on it ([#15369](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15369)) by @qqqys - Adds X-DashScope-Source-Config to matching QwenCloud and Qianwen AI Platform requests to identify site and client, without changing authentication or retries. ([#15041](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15041)) by @yiliang114 - Resumed OpenTUI sessions now retain recorded text, images, tool results, and prompt identities, while rewind restores transcript, request, and draft. ([#15384](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15384)) by @chiga0 - OpenTUI now captures complete checkpoints at edit approvals and restores them safely, preserving conversation metadata and blocking stale or cancelled owners. ([#15389](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15389)) by @chiga0 - Adds automation.scanner-threads to run managed automation scanner rows on a dedicated pool and leases rows from claim time. ([#15442](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15442)) by @yiliang114 - Adds Continue analysis with current parameters so Generated UI users can review and send frozen parameters to the original session. ([#15333](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15333)) by @qqqys - Adds an opt-in external-scratch Runtime provider that lets an operator-run HTTP service place Session workers while preserving attestation and recovery. ([#15261](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15261)) by @yiliang114 - Adds a prompt argument hint for /verify-pr so users can see the PR number and supported flags such as --publish and --watch. ([#15463](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15463)) by @wenshao - Adds a durable queue for messages sent during a Managed Turn, allowing queued text and file references to be delivered, edited, withdrawn, or resumed safely. ([#15449](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15449)) by @doudouOUC - Adds /autofix-pr status to list all watches in a clone and lets users resume a watch in a later session. ([#15510](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15510)) by @wenshao - Adds a Git URL source to the Web Shell Add-workspace dialog so users can clone a repository and open it as a workspace in the browser. ([#15361](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15361)) by @wenshao - Enables image and PDF delivery for managed runtime providers with a 768 KiB base64 media limit and a 896 KiB tool-result limit. ([#13606](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13606)) by @water-in-stone - feat(managed-agent): give the Hosted Harness its Broker through the environment ([#15244](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15244)) by @wenshao - Adds an operator endpoint to register immutable, idempotent EXTERNAL Workspace storage ownership with provider identity and tenant alias. ([#15516](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15516)) by @yiliang114 - UserPromptSubmit hooks no longer re-append byte-identical additionalContext within a session, avoiding duplicate context and keeping transcripts accurate. ([#14129](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14129)) by @yiliang114 - Mods can now observe turn.start and turn.complete events in headless and terminal runs, and use $.turn.abort to end a running turn. ([#15488](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15488)) by @yiliang114 - Tests now capture expected disk-full log output so real CI disk-full failures are easier to distinguish from deliberate test errors. Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - feat(daemon): support session-targeted Skill and Extension refresh ([#14050](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14050)) by @callmeYe - feat(runtime-broker): Session-create warm for Workspace-isolated bound Sessions ([#14599](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14599)) by @doudouOUC - feat(managed-agent): ship a configuration template in the reference distribution ([#14631](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14631)) by @wenshao - feat(serve): run private CSI file turns through Hosted Harness ([#14487](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487)) by @doudouOUC - feat(managed-agent): support local and SSH workspace file references ([#14639](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14639)) by @doudouOUC - Adds a read-only --check preflight that prints PASS, WARN, FAIL, or SKIP for managed-agent deployment checks and exits nonzero on failure. ([#14632](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14632)) by @wenshao - Lets a successor Hosted owner finish private CSI file turns that already have durable receipts, preserving tool responses and avoiding repeated file operations. ([#14523](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14523)) by @doudouOUC - Managed Agent submissions now accept up to 8 MiB of attachment input, preserve large pending requests across refresh, and let users discard unrecoverable drafts. ([#14628](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14628)) by @doudouOUC - Hosted Turn recovery now asks the Runtime Broker for execution evidence and treats unprovable outcomes as unknown instead of transient faults. ([#14669](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14669)) by @wenshao - Adds systemd units and setup guidance for single-host managed-agent deployments so Runtime workers stay running when Broker restarts ([#14633](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14633)) by @wenshao - Parks managed-agent turns with unknown Runtime outcomes for later rechecks instead of repeatedly retrying cancellation, keeping them active and avoiding false FAILED results ([#14681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14681)) by @wenshao - feat(artifacts): record files the agent creates or edits ([#14292](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14292)) by @zjgzx1988 - Adds a managed-agent credential bootstrap that generates required deployment tokens and writes protected configuration to simplify secure setup. ([#14634](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14634)) by @wenshao - Completes private CSI cold recovery so settled file work can resume from saved results without repeating file effects or extra model requests. ([#14695](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14695)) by @doudouOUC - Adds an optional Generated UI extension that renders model-generated HTML/CSS cards with bounded local JavaScript, letting users adjust inputs without another model turn.     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Adds optional model-generated layouts to Test Failure Explorer, with validation and fallback to the fixed view ([#14269](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14269)) by @qqqys - The Web Shell mobile composer no longer shows the ↑ and ↓ history buttons, reducing clutter while keeping history search available. ([#14220](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14220)) by @pomelo-nwu - The Web Shell trajectory panel now includes a collapsible Recent executions section that shows live requests and tools with elapsed time and final durations. ([#14071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14071)) by @qqqys - Managed sessions created from published AgentDefinitions can now load static Skills and pass pinned MCP server and Hook catalog selections to Hosted Runtimes. ([#14319](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14319)) by @doudouOUC - Files now offers New file and New folder actions, and folder Delete asks for a second confirmation before permanently removing the folder and its contents. ([#14169](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14169)) by @ytahdn - Eligible legacy cancellations now require confirmation through the daemon or WebShell Continue flow before continuing, while explicitly user-cancelled work stays blocked. ([#14087](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14087)) by @yiliang114 - Hosted parent agents can launch snapshot-isolated child agents that read a frozen workspace copy without changing files, running commands, or affecting the parent. ([#14265](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14265)) by @wenshao - Clicking the workspace folder beside the chat title now opens and selects the Files tree in the right panel, with keyboard and focus preserved. ([#14344](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14344)) by @ytahdn - Managed sessions now integrate into the home and sidebar, supporting workspace creation, approval policy and model selection, and context usage in the composer. ([#14316](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14316)) by @doudouOUC - The Files panel adds a Delete menu for regular files, requiring a permanent-deletion confirmation for the selected trusted local workspace. ([#14158](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14158)) by @ytahdn - Adds resident Kubernetes Workspace file sessions that retain an original Pod and fixed CSI PVC so configured Workspaces preserve files across sessions. ([#14340](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14340)) by @doudouOUC - Adds Shell Full Access and default/auto-edit/yolo switching for built-in Workspace-bound qwen-code Sessions without losing history, Workspace, or drafts. ([#14323](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14323)) by @doudouOUC - feat(mods): support commands in interactive terminals (PR4a) ([#14268](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14268)) by @qqqys - feat(providers): add QwenCloud as the first /auth entry ([#14073](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14073)) by @yiliang114 - feat(ci): route the release lane's hosted stragglers onto ECS runners ([#14336](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14336)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes plan approval crashes during journal-only interrupted turns so takeover can settle the session instead of failing terminally ([#14160](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14160)) by @wenshao - Fixes checkstyle build failures in the Java SDK by reordering FG8 test imports ([#14305](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14305)) by @wenshao - Standardizes Managed Agent timestamps to Unix epoch milliseconds and updates query mappings for consistent data handling ([#14185](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14185)) by @doudouOUC - Fixes CSI preparation failures by retaining input, tool declaration, and intent resources through the HTTP store ([#14180](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14180)) by @doudouOUC - Managed Hosted model prompts now stay aligned with declared tools, including empty or changed tool sets, so tool guidance and examples remain accurate. ([#14306](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14306)) by @doudouOUC - Closing a parent session now stops each child session's running Turn, reducing lingering background work and making close behavior more reliable. ([#14218](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14218)) by @wenshao - Session close after a Harness restart or takeover now correctly tracks and releases held background Shell or Monitor runtimes, preventing abandoned runs. ([#13986](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13986)) by @wenshao - fix(managed-agent): name the plan's size and room in the team-plan bound refusal ([#14057](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14057)) by @wenshao - Windows merge checks now report known workspace and script failures as warnings while keeping installer, security, and Hosted process tests blocking. ([#14298](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14298)) by @yiliang114 - Managed-agent retry loops now have budgets and terminal states, letting stuck projections fail safely, reducing repeated log noise and preventing endless retries. ([#13219](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13219)) by @wenshao - When a hosted member message reply times out, the CLI now advises not to resend because the recipient may already have it or receive it later. ([#14296](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14296)) by @yiliang114 - Dialogs opened over the mobile sidebar drawer remain touch-scrollable instead of being locked by the drawer's background scroll behavior. ([#14217](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14217)) by @pomelo-nwu - Managed agent publication grants and background session close now work reliably for Shell and Monitor output. ([#14364](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14364)) by @doudouOUC - Fixes CLI custom commands so injected file content is preserved during later shell and argument interpolation instead of being reinterpreted. ([#14295](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14295)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes Web Shell so Show Response Tokens Per Second displays an estimated t/s rate beside the streaming token counter when enabled. ([#14294](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14294)) by @yiliang114 - Polishes Web Shell file display and preview by showing safe file names, preserving paths, adding a close-preview action, and limiting syntax highlighting resources. ([#14143](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14143)) by @ytahdn - Routes post-merge classifier jobs to ECS when enabled and lets CLI test workers yield between tests to drain queued progress replies.
